steps.name: 슬라이드 속성(요소 선택 없음) - 글꼴 세트 선택 상자가 패널 안(말줄임) · 아래 보조 글줄
steps.js: const P=document.querySelector('#tab-props'); const sel=document.querySelector('select[data-slide="fontPreset"]'); const d=document.querySelector('select[data-deckfont]'); if(!sel||!d) return 'no selects'; const pr=P.getBoundingClientRect().right; const w1=sel.getBoundingClientRect(), w2=d.getBoundingClientRect(); const subs=[...P.querySelectorAll('.sub')]; const ell=getComputedStyle(d).textOverflow==='ellipsis'; return w1.right<=pr+1 && w2.right<=pr+1 && subs.length===2 && subs.every(x=>x.textContent.trim().length>0) && ell && !document.querySelector('.scrollx') ? true : 'sel right='+w1.right+' deck right='+w2.right+' panel right='+pr+' subs='+subs.length+' ell='+ell

steps.name: 선택지 글은 전체(이름 · 글꼴 구성) · 보조 글줄은 패널 폭 안
steps.js: const d=document.querySelector('select[data-deckfont]'); const opt=[...d.options].slice(1); const P=document.querySelector('#tab-props').getBoundingClientRect(); const sub=document.querySelector('#tab-props .sub').getBoundingClientRect(); return opt.length>=1 && opt.every(o=>o.textContent.includes(' · ')) && sub.right<=P.right+1 ? true : 'opts='+opt.length+' sub right='+sub.right+' panel='+P.right

steps.name: 요소 목록은 줄을 자르지 않고 목록 전체 가로 스크롤
steps.js: const L=document.querySelector('#tab-props .ellist'); const row=L.querySelector('div'); const cs=getComputedStyle(row); return getComputedStyle(L).overflowX==='auto' && cs.textOverflow!=='ellipsis' && cs.whiteSpace==='nowrap' ? true : 'ox='+getComputedStyle(L).overflowX+' to='+cs.textOverflow

steps.name: 색 선택 상자도 패널 안
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const P=document.querySelector('#tab-props').getBoundingClientRect().right; const bad=[...document.querySelectorAll('#tab-props select')].filter(s=>s.getBoundingClientRect().right>P+1); return bad.length===0 ? true : 'overflow='+bad.length
